name: Honolulu Zoo Junior Leader Program
what_you_do: Teens help the Education team during Zoo Camp. They do outdoor science, guide younger campers and set a good example.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 13 to 16 who can volunteer at least one full week of Zoo Camp.
duration: At least one full Zoo Camp week (Mon to Fri, 8:00 am to 2:30 pm, with extended hours to 5:30 pm). Camps run in spring, summer, fall and winter.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. First-time volunteers are asked to start in spring, fall or winter camp if possible.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Volunteer Application. Upload a signed Waiver of Liability and a current photo. Then set up an interview. It can be in person or on Zoom. Training is the general volunteer orientation and a zoo safety class.
notes: Regular zoo volunteer roles are 18 and older; this is the teen exception. Check the page for the current camp schedule.
